title: Keep Your Kitchen Sink Flowing Freely
description: Your kitchen sink works hard every day, but cooking fats, food scraps, and soap scum can quickly slow down your drainage. To keep your pipes clear, always wipe greasy pans with a paper towel before washing them, and pour liquid fats into a container rather than down the drain. Run hot water after each dishwashing session to flush away remaining soap residues. Installing a simple mesh drain strainer will catch food debris before it causes a clog. If you notice persistent slow draining or unpleasant odors despite good habits, it may be time for a professional plumbing inspection to clean your line safely.
